# SessionContext

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Execution.SessionContext`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Holds session-scoped state for a query execution session, including temp table data, cursor state, and impersonation context. Temp tables (names starting with #) are stored in memory and persist across statements within the same session.

Capture source: `a0feb138f00575d35634565f3a733deb9e65ca98`, tree `904cce706d298d3f0ed62ea095bdcdd78d584101` (final-C Release candidate; not a published stable package).

```text
public PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.QueryRow FetchNextFromCursor(System.String cursorName)
```

Fetches the next row from an open cursor. Advances the cursor position and updates P:PPDS.Query.Execution.SessionContext.FetchStatus. Returns null if the cursor is past the end.

- Parameter `cursorName`: The cursor name.

Returns: The next row, or null if past end.

#### DeclareCursor

```text
public System.Void DeclareCursor(System.String cursorName, PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.IQueryPlanNode queryNode)
```

Declares a cursor with the given name and associated query plan node. The cursor is not yet open; call PPDS.Query.Execution.SessionContext.OpenCursorAsync(System.String,PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.QueryPlanContext,System.Threading.CancellationToken) to execute the query.

- Parameter `cursorName`: The cursor name (case-insensitive).
- Parameter `queryNode`: The plan node for the cursor&#x27;s SELECT query.

### Properties

#### ErrorNumber

```text
System.Int32 ErrorNumber { get; set; }
```

@@ERROR value — the error number from the last statement. 0 means success.


#### FetchStatus

```text
System.Int32 FetchStatus { get; set; }
```

The current @@FETCH_STATUS value. 0 = success, -1 = past end of cursor, -2 = row not found.


#### CallerObjectId

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Guid> CallerObjectId { get; set; }
```

Optional CallerObjectId for impersonation (EXECUTE AS USER). When set, Dataverse requests should use this as the CallerObjectId. Null means no impersonation is active.

System.String ErrorMessage { get; set; }

ERROR_MESSAGE() value — the error message from the last caught exception.
